title: From Sorry to QED: Refining LLM Math Proofs via Angelic Execution
abstract: arXiv:2611.22103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can now generate Lean proof scripts that capture the high-level structure of many mathematical arguments. However, these scripts frequently fail on complex theorems: a single missing side condition or misapplied lemma can cause the prover to abort early and discard an otherwise viable proof outline. This paper presents MathEye, a framework that converts imperfect LLM-generated proof scripts into fully verified Lean proofs by combining symbolic reasoning with minimal human interaction. At the core of MathEye is angelic proof checking, an optimistic execution model that replaces failing proof fragments with placeholders while preserving the overall structure of the argument. This optimistic check produces an angelic proof that isolates the exact proof obligations that the LLM fails to discharge. translated_title: 从Sorry到QED：通过天使执行精炼大语言模型的数学证明
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如今能够生成捕捉许多数学论证高层次结构的Lean证明脚本。然而，这些脚本在处理复杂定理时经常失败：一个缺失的附带条件或误用的引理就可能导致证明器提前中止，并丢弃原本可行的证明大纲。本文提出了MathEye，一个通过将符号推理与最少的人类交互相结合，把不完善的LLM生成证明脚本转化为完全验证的Lean证明的框架。MathEye的核心是天使证明检查，这是一种乐观执行模型，它在保留论证整体结构的同时，用占位符替换失败的证明片段。这种乐观检查产生一个天使证明，能够精确分离出LLM无法完成的证明义务。由于这些未解决的义务往往在逻辑上相互依赖，让数学家处理每一个占位符……
tldr: 本文提出MathEye框架，其核心“天使证明检查”以乐观执行方式将LLM生成的Lean证明脚本中失败片段替换为占位符，在保留整体证明结构的同时精确定位失败点，从而以最少的人工交互把不完善的证明转化为完全验证的Lean证明。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MathEye, whose core "angelic proof checking" optimistically replaces failing proof fragments in LLM-generated Lean scripts with placeholders to isolate exact proof obligations, converting imperfect proofs into fully verified Lean proofs with minimal human interaction.
